column1: # Relay backlog (#1831). Jobs a relay event (workflow_dispatch, workflow_call,
# repository_dispatch) reaches that can resolve to a persistent runner, present
# before ADR 0235 scanned relays. The digest here is the relay digest: SHA-256
# over the job's selector and its unresolved reason names, so a changed selector
# or a new reason (head-materialization in particular) makes the row stop
# applying. No new row may be added; each leaves by moving to the ephemeral lane
# or, when head detection finds no pattern, by gaining a reviewed entry.
